description: Establish a green baseline and a NEW branch off main before making changes. Confirm the existing backend and render suites pass so any later failure is attributable to this change.
steps: From repo root /projects/sandbox/chhath-full-codebase, create a new branch off main for this fix: git checkout main && git checkout -b fix/pdf-export-blank-report (do NOT push).
Run the backend suite: cd mgmt/backend && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs — confirm 1083 pass / 0 fail.
Run the render suite: cd mgmt/server-render && node --test test/*.test.mjs — confirm it is green (~199).
Record the baseline pass counts in this feature's findings.
